biggest_catch: This is not one $600 check — it's $100 a month for 6 straight months of $1,000+ payroll direct deposits, and missing a single month kills the remaining bonuses; one official variant is restricted to Florida branches.
catches: Up to $600 is paid in six $100 increments — one per month in which $1,000+ in qualifying direct deposits post, for six consecutive months from enrollment.

Qualifying direct deposits are payroll/pension/government ACH deposits; P2P (Venmo, PayPal, Cash App, Zelle), external transfers, Wise/Astra, merchant credits, checks, cash, wires, ATM and online/mobile transfers, and micro-deposits do NOT count.
Direct deposits must begin before the start of the second month; missing a month ends the promotion and bars future similar offers.
Enrollment in Online Banking and eStatements is required.
New members ONLY — anyone who has ever had any Teachers FCU account or membership is excluded; non-member joint account holders not eligible; one per primary member.

The variant verified here is valid only at Teachers branch locations in the state of Florida (offer began August 1, 2026); a general new-member offer page carried offer code JOIN600 — confirm which variant covers your state before applying.
Business and trust accounts are not eligible; bonuses reported on 1099-MISC.
Offer may be modified or discontinued at any time; bonuses can be rescinded for violations.

steps: Join Teachers FCU (open a Regular or Youth Savings account with your ID and SSN/ITIN) — only if you have never had any Teachers FCU account.
Open a new Smart Checking, Share Draft Checking, or Young Professional Checking account.
Enroll in Online Banking and select eStatements (Additional Services menu).

Have your employer/pension/government agency direct-deposit at least $1,000 each month into the new checking account, starting before the second month — P2P, external transfers, and cash/check deposits do not count.
Keep the $1,000+/month direct deposits posting for six consecutive months; each qualifying month earns $100, deposited to your savings within 30 days.
timing: Each $100 increment deposited to the primary member's savings within 30 calendar days after the qualifying month; six $100 payments over six months of qualifying direct deposits.
